messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up: planning to enable per-tenant quota config in prod at 11:20 PT. Canary plan: 5% random tenants for 30m, then 25% for 1h if no regressions. Need ops + console UX signoff and telemetry dashboards live. @oncall FYI :rocket:

sam: question  what exactly is the fallback if a tenant unexpectedly hits the new quota?

olivia: fallback = soft-throttle + route to legacy quota pool; we also expose ephemeral override (TTL 15m) for emergency unblocks. will update runbook.

jordan: telemetry preflight is ready. we tag traces with header `X-Quota-Canary: true`. script: `./scripts/canary_run.sh --canary-percent 5 --duration 30m`

anya: metrics to watch: `tenant_error_rate`, `route_miss_ratio`, `quota_bump_count`, p95/p99 routing latency, and `quota_override_used`. can we add panel showing top 10 tenants by override usage? :eyes:

mike: console UX: add a transient banner "Canary active: 5% tenants" with link to runbook and a one-click rollback that triggers override TTL and pauses rollout. audit log should include operator id + snapshot id.

olivia: will wire rollback button to POST /internal/configs/{id}/pause (requires ops audit header). sample payload: {"operator":"<id>","reason":"rollback from console","snapshot":"snap-2026-03-23-1120"}

sam: is rollback idempotent? double clicks can happen.

jordan: yes idempotent; API returns 200 if snapshot already paused. backend uses snapshot CAS with ETag. UI will include small backoff.

ops-bot: Deployment job queued: `canary-rollout-1779819999` scheduled at 2026-03-23T11:20:00Z. Link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/1779819999 :robot_face:

anya: propose telemetry alert thresholds: tenant_error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, route_miss_ratio delta > 2% vs baseline, p99 latency increase > 30%. any alert auto-pauses rollout.

mike: confirm audit retention for this action is 90 days for compliance. ops ok with that?

olivia: confirmed 90d retention. checklist: preflight smoke ✅, dashboard panels live ✅, rollback button wired ✅, runbook link added ✅. initiating canary.

sam: will monitor dashboards. gl :thumbsup:

mike: oncall will watch from #eng-oncall during window. :lock:

olivia: flipping in 5, will post updates.

ops-bot: Deployment started: `canary-rollout-1779819999` at 2026-03-23T11:20:12Z.

olivia: canary flipped to 5%  traces and metrics streaming. ping if anything odd.

jordan: seeing expected `X-Quota-Canary` traces in canary stream. no error spikes yet.

anya: dashboard shows small p95 blip, p99 steady. overrides = 0.

sam: thumbs-up.

olivia: holding 30m then bump to 25% if green. :hourglass:
